newsitem.title: USA: Granite, Yahoo! launch new program.
newsitem.headline: Granite, Yahoo! launch new program.

text.p: Granite Broadcasting Corp and Yahoo! Inc said on Monday they have begun airing their integrated Internet and television broadcast news programming in all nine of Granite's television station markets.
The company's nine stations reach 5.7 percent of the nation's television households.
Under the deal, Yahoo!, an online Internet guide, features local news feeds from Granite stations on the World Wide Web.
In exchange, the Granite stations are using information from the Internet provided by Yahoo! and telling viewers where to find more information about newscasts on the Internet.
Granite owns and operates nine network affiliate stations in California, Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, Texas and Wisconsin.
Reuters Holdings Plc owns a minority interest in Yahoo!
